prompt: A clean game sprite on TRUE TRANSPARENT background: one small squat gray-purple STONE COFFIN with a chunky pitched lid and just two thin gold engraved decorative lines. Tall compact silhouette with short length and deep stone sides. 2:1 isometric, upper-left lighting. Soft dark plum outlines, rounded hand-painted flat cartoon shapes with 3 shade levels. Absolutely crisp clean silhouette against pure transparency. No light effects anywhere, no haze, no aura, no fog, no blur, no background colors. The only semitransparent element is a small FLAT OVAL ground contact shadow below the base. Preserve empty space around the complete isolated object. The item should fill a 60px wide by 60px high box when reduced for gameplay. No words or symbols or ornament beyond gold lines.
